programme.title: Monsters Inside Me
programme.sub-title: The Beach, the Bug and the Bite
programme.desc: Unremarkable moments become medical nightmares when parasites and other hidden invaders attack the human body; patients, loved ones and doctors retrace steps to search for answers, while experts reveal the science behind each ordeal and fight to survive.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
programme.desc: Abandoned hangers and bunkers populate a bizarre facility in the middle of nowhere, but among them are other structures whose purpose are oddly obscured; experts investigate a highly-classified military cover-up with extraterrestrial objectives.

programme.title: Flesh & Blood
programme.desc: After being hired for an aborted coup, a group of unscrupulous warriors is abruptly disbanded. One of the mercenaries, Martin (Rutger Hauer), is determined to get revenge on his dismissive employer, Arnolfini (Fernando Hillbeck). To carry out his plan, Martin abducts the lovely Agnes (Jennifer Jason Leigh), the intended wife of Arnolfini's son, Steven (Tom Burlinson). Soon Martin and Steven are locked in an ongoing battle to see who will ultimately win the hand of Agnes.

programme.title: Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: When a group of civil rights workers goes missing in a small Mississippi town, FBI agents Alan Ward (Willem Dafoe) and Rupert Anderson (Gene Hackman) are sent in to investigate. Local authorities refuse to cooperate with them, and the African American community is afraid to, precipitating a clash between the two agents over strategy. As the situation becomes more volatile, the direct approach is abandoned in favor of more aggressive, hard-line tactics.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A teenage hacker finds himself framed for the theft of millions of dollars from a major corporation. Master hacker Dade Murphy, aka Zero Cool, aka Crash Override, has been banned from touching a keyboard for seven years after crashing over 1,500 Wall Street computers at the age of 11. Now keen to get back in front of a monitor, he finds himself in more trouble than ever.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: Naive Midwestern prep student Jonathan (Andrew McCarthy) bonds with his more worldly roommate, Skip (Rob Lowe), who takes the small-town boy under his wing. At Skip's urging, the inexperienced Jonathan is emboldened to seek out older women in the cocktail lounges of nearby Chicago, where he meets and beds the alluring Ellen (Jacqueline Bisset), who unfortunately turns out to be Skip's mother. The division between the friends is further deepened when a cheating scandal engulfs the school.

programme.title: Action Point
programme.desc: D.C. is the crackpot owner of Action Point -- a low-rent, out-of-control amusement park where the rides are designed with minimum safety for maximum fun. Just as his estranged daughter Boogie comes to visit, a corporate mega-park opens nearby and jeopardizes the future of Action Point. To save his beloved park and his relationship with Boogie, D.C. and his loony crew of misfits must risk everything to pull out all the stops and save the day.

programme.title: North Dallas Forty
programme.desc: A brutal satire of American professional football in which a veteran pass-catcher's individuality and refusal to become part of the team family is bitterly resented by his disciplinarian coaches. The National Football League refused to help in the production of this movie, suggesting it may have been too near the truth for comfort. From the novel by former NFL player Peter Gent.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: When a dangerous crime wave hits the beach, the legendary Mitch Buchannon leads his elite squad of lifeguards on a mission to prove that you don't have to wear a badge to save the bay. Joined by a trio of hotshot recruits, including former Olympian Matt Brody, they ditch the surf and go deep undercover to take down a ruthless businesswoman whose devious plans threaten the future of the bay.

programme.title: The Institute
programme.desc: Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally.

programme.title: Secret Service
programme.desc: MI6 agent Kate Henderson uncovers an audacious plot involving Russia and an asset in the UK Cabinet; Kate's hunt for the mole puts her agent's life at risk.

programme.title: Barbershop
programme.desc: A smart comedy about a day in the life of a barbershop on the south side of Chicago. Calvin (Ice Cube), who inherited the struggling business from his deceased father, views the shop as nothing but a burden and a waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy and struggles with the notion that he just sold it out.

programme.title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
programme.desc: This sequel to the 2002 film returns to the Chicago barbershop owned by Calvin Palmer Jr. (Ice Cube). His employees -- Isaac (Troy Garity), Terri (Eve), Ricky (Michael Ealy), Dinka (Leonard Earl Howze) and Kenard -- have their own personal and workplace problems, and a new barbershop called Nappy Cutz has moved in across the street. As Calvin tries to change the character of his business, Nappy Cutz and gentrification become a threat to the surrounding community.

programme.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
programme.desc: To survive harsh economic times, Calvin and Angie have merged the barbershop and beauty salon into one business. The days of male bonding are gone as Eddie and the crew must now contend with sassy female co-workers and spirited clientele. As the battle of the sexes rages on, a different kind of conflict has taken over Chicago. Crime and gangs are on the rise, leaving Calvin worried about the fate of his son. Together, the friends come up with a bold plan to take back their beloved neighborhood.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band whether they should honor their agreement.

programme.title: The Passenger
programme.desc: Randy is perfectly content to fade into the background, but when one of his co-workers goes on a sudden and violent rampage, he must face his fears and confront his troubled past to survive.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: An embittered Indian scout attempts to escort a homesteader's wife and her son back to safety after her cowardly husband deserts her during an Apache attack. When she refuses to go, the scout stays on to help for a while and, over time, forms a strong bond with both her and her son.

programme.title: Suburbicon
programme.desc: Suburbicon is a peaceful, idyllic, suburban community with affordable homes and manicured lawns -- the perfect place to raise a family, and in the summer of 1959, the Lodge family is doing just that. But the tranquil surface masks a disturbing reality, as husband and father Gardner Lodge must navigate the town's dark underbelly of betrayal, deceit and violence.

programme.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
programme.desc: In the Southwest during the Civil War, a mysterious stranger, Joe (Clint Eastwood), and a Mexican outlaw, Tuco (Eli Wallach), form an uneasy partnership -- Joe turns in the bandit for the reward money, then rescues him just as he is being hanged. When Joe's shot at the noose goes awry during one escapade, a furious Tuco tries to have him murdered. The men re-team abruptly, however, to beat out a sadistic criminal and the Union army and find $20,000 that a soldier has buried in the desert.

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret.

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: For 60 years, a mysterious monk with no name has zigzagged the globe to protect an ancient scroll -- a scroll that holds the key to unlimited power. Now the Monk must look for a new scroll keeper. Kar is an unlikely candidate, a streetwise young man whose only interest is himself. But when he inadvertently saves the Bulletproof Monk from capture, the two become partners in a scheme to save the world from the scroll's most avid pursuer.

programme.title: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: When her teenage daughter opts out of Thanksgiving, single mother Claudia Larson (Holly Hunter) travels alone to her childhood home for an explosive holiday dinner with her dysfunctional family. Claudia quickly tires of her parents, her long-suffering sister (Cynthia Stevenson), her snobby brother-in-law (Steve Guttenberg) and her nutty aunt (Geraldine Chaplin). But the evening gets interesting when sparks fly between Claudia and her brother's handsome friend Leo Fish (Dylan McDermott).

programme.title: Fargo
programme.desc: "Fargo" is a reality-based crime drama set in Minnesota in 1987. Jerry Lundegaard (William H. Macy) is a car salesman in Minneapolis who has gotten himself into debt and is so desperate for money that he hires two thugs (Steve Buscemi), (Peter Stormare) to kidnap his own wife. Jerry will collect the ransom from her wealthy father (Harve Presnell), paying the thugs a small portion and keeping the rest to satisfy his debts. The scheme collapses when the thugs shoot a state trooper.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Secret Service
programme.desc: MI6 agent Kate Henderson uncovers an audacious plot involving Russia and an asset in the UK Cabinet; Kate's hunt for the mole puts her agent's life at risk.

programme.title: The Institute
programme.desc: Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally.

programme.title: New Wave
programme.desc: Inspired by punk's DIY energy and David Bowie, a new generation of outsider artists sparks a movement that becomes known as New Wave.

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Imprisoned during World War II in a German POW camp, a group of Allied soldiers are intent on breaking out, not only to escape, but also to draw Nazi forces away from battle to search for fugitives. Among the prisoners determined to escape are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett. Outwitting their captors by digging a tunnel out of the prison grounds, the soldiers find the stakes much higher when escape becomes a reality.

programme.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
programme.desc: Former cinema superhero Riggan Thomson (Michael Keaton) is mounting an ambitious Broadway production that he hopes will breathe new life into his stagnant career. It's risky, but he hopes that his creative gamble will prove that he's a real artist and not just a washed-up movie star. As opening night approaches, a castmate is injured, forcing Riggan to hire an actor (Edward Norton) who is guaranteed to shake things up. Meanwhile, Riggan must deal with his girlfriend, daughter and ex-wife.

programme.title: Great Photo, Lovely Life
programme.desc: Photojournalist Amanda Mustard turns her investigative lens on sexual abuse committed by her grandfather, beginning a personal journey in pursuit of the truth and reconciliation for her family.

programme.title: When We Were Bullies
programme.desc: A coincidence leads filmmaker Jay Rosenblatt to track down his fifth-grade class and fifth-grade teacher to examine their memory of and complicity in a bullying incident 50 years ago.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: It's summer, and Greg Heffley (Zachary Gordon) is looking forward to playing video games and spending time with his friends. However, Greg's dad (Steve Zahn) has other plans: He's decided that some father-son bonding time is in order. Desperate to prevent his dad from ruining summer vacation, Greg pretends he has a job at a ritzy country club. But Greg's plan backfires, leaving him in the middle of embarrassing mishaps and a camping trip gone wrong.

programme.title: ParaNorman
programme.desc: Young Norman Babcock (Kodi Smit-McPhee) has the ability to speak with the dead -- and he often prefers their company to that of the living. Norman receives word from his strange Uncle Prenderghast (John Goodman) that a centuries-old witch's curse on their town is real and about to come true -- and that only Norman can stop it. When zombies rise from their graves, Norman must summon all his courage and compassion and push his paranormal abilities to the limit to save his fellow townspeople.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' Horton Hears a Who!
programme.desc: Animated elephant Horton finds a speck of dust floating in the Jungle of Nool. Upon investigation of the speck, Horton discovers the tiny city of Whoville and its residents, the Whos, which he can hear but cannot see. Horton forms a friendship with the mayor of Whoville, Ned McDodd, and promises to transport Whoville to safety. However, Horton encounters opposition from his jungle neighbors, who don't want to believe in the existence of Whoville.

programme.title: Boys Go to Jupiter
programme.desc: Billy 5000, a teenage gig worker with a rise-and-grind mindset, aims to make $5,000. His quest is derailed by a gelatinous alien's appearance.

programme.title: Supergirl
programme.desc: Kara (Helen Slater) of Argo City poses as Clark Kent's cousin, Linda Lee, to recover the Omegahedron from a witch (Faye Dunaway).

programme.title: The Conjuring
programme.desc: In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history.

programme.title: The Conjuring 2
programme.desc: In 1977, paranormal investigators Ed (Patrick Wilson) and Lorraine Warren come out of a self-imposed sabbatical to travel to Enfield, a borough in north London. There, they meet Peggy Hodgson, an overwhelmed single mother of four who tells the couple that something evil is in her home. Ed and Lorraine believe her story when the youngest daughter starts to show signs of demonic possession. As the Warrens try to help the besieged girl, they become the next targets of the malicious spirit.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists newfound ally Diana Prince to face an even greater threat. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to recruit a team to stand against this newly awakened enemy. Despite the formation of an unprecedented league of heroes -- Batman, Wonder Woman, Aquaman, Cyborg and the Flash -- it may be too late to save the planet from an assault of catastrophic proportions.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: When Superman gets drawn into conflicts at home and abroad, his actions are questioned, giving tech billionaire Lex Luthor the opportunity to get the Man of Steel out of the way for good. Will intrepid reporter Lois Lane and Superman's four-legged companion, Krypto, be able to help him before it's too late?

programme.title: Supergirl
programme.desc: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Supergirl reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion for an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

programme.title: Blockers
programme.desc: Julie, Kayla and Sam are three high school seniors who make a pact to lose their virginity on prom night. Lisa, Mitchell and Hunter are three overprotective parents who flip out when they find out about their daughters' plans. They soon join forces for a wild and chaotic quest to stop the girls from sealing the deal -- no matter what the cost.

programme.title: Magic Mike's Last Dance
programme.desc: Mike Lane takes to the stage once again when a business deal that went bust leaves him broke and bartending in Florida. Hoping for one last hurrah, Mike heads to London with a wealthy socialite who lures him with an offer he can't refuse -- and an agenda all her own. With everything on the line, he soon finds himself trying to whip a hot new roster of talented dancers into shape.

programme.title: The Soul of America
programme.desc: Writer, journalist, historian and presidential biographer Jon Meacham offers his timely and invaluable insights into the United States' current political and historical moment by examining its past struggles with racism, sexism and xenophobia.

programme.title: The Words That Built America
programme.desc: Filmmaker Alexandra Pelosi brings together over 100 people, including all the living presidents and vice presidents, to read the Declaration of Independence, the United States Constitution and the Bill of Rights.

programme.title: Green Lantern: First Flight
programme.desc: The Green Lantern must race against time to stop Sinestro from unleashing a sinister plot.

programme.title: Green Lantern: Emerald Knights
programme.desc: New recruit Arisia (Elisabeth Moss) joins forces with Hal Jordan (Nathan Fillion) to save the universe from the forces of Krona.

programme.title: Green Lantern: Beware My Power
programme.desc: When a Power Ring is bestowed upon former Marine John Stewart, it leads him on a life-changing mission. With Justice League member Green Arrow and Thanagarian Hawkgirl by his side, Stewart is thrown into a complicated galactic war.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Sworn to preserve intergalactic order, the Green Lantern Corps has existed for centuries. Its newest recruit, Hal Jordan, is the first human to join the ranks. The Green Lanterns have little regard for humans, who have thus far been unable to harness the powers of the ring each member wears. But Jordan, a gifted and cocky test pilot, may be the corps' only hope when a new enemy called Parallax threatens the universal balance of power.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: After 10 years of marriage and two children, it seems that Greg Focker has finally earned a place in the "circle of trust" of his uptight father-in-law, Jack. However, Greg is moonlighting with a drug company, which raises Jack's suspicions. As two clans descend on the scene of the young twins' birthday party, Greg must find a way through myriad misunderstandings to prove to Jack -- once and for all -- that he is worthy of being the next family patriarch.

programme.title: The Royal Tenenbaums
programme.desc: Royal Tenenbaum and his wife, Etheline, had three genius children, Chas, Margot and Richie, before separating. Virtually all memory of the brilliance of the young Tenenbaums was subsequently erased by two decades of betrayal, failure, and disaster, until the family experiences an unexpected reunion and gather under the same roof.

programme.title: Battle of the Sexes
programme.desc: The 1973 tennis match between Billie Jean King and Bobby Riggs became the most watched televised sports event of all time. Trapped in the media glare, King and Riggs were on opposites sides of a binary argument, but off-court each was fighting more personal and complex battles. With her husband urging her to fight for equal pay, the private King was also struggling to come to terms with her own sexuality, while Riggs gambled his legacy and reputation in a bid to relive the glories of his past.

programme.title: Fackham Hall
programme.desc: Eric Noone begins a forbidden romance with Rose Davenport, the lady of the house at a posh English manor. When an unexpected murder occurs, Eric gets framed, leaving Rose and her family's future uncertain.

programme.title: The Death of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: A scientist revives a murdered woman as a companion for a legendary creature. The aftermath defies all expectations.

programme.title: Anatomy of a Fall
programme.desc: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

programme.title: Marty Supreme
programme.desc: Marty Mauser, a wily hustler with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: Godzilla, King of the Monsters!
programme.desc: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast.

programme.title: The Man
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity leaves an ATF agent (Samuel L. Jackson) squabbling with a talkative salesman (Eugene Levy) in his custody.

programme.title: Man Down
programme.desc: With help from his best friend (Jai Courtney), a Marine (Shia LaBeouf) embarks on a desperate search to find his wife (Kate Mara) and son (Charlie Shotwell) in post-apocalyptic America.

programme.title: Open Water
programme.desc: Scuba divers (Blanchard Ryan, Daniel Travis) struggle to survive in shark-infested waters after their tour boat accidentally leaves them behind.

programme.title: Smoking Tigers
programme.desc: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Partnered with a mysterious stranger (Dave Franco), a high school senior (Emma Roberts) joins a popular online game that dares players to perform increasingly dangerous stunts.

programme.title: Shot Caller
programme.desc: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

programme.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
programme.desc: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) and his estranged son (Jai Courtney) must put aside their differences and work together to get a Russian whistleblower to safety and thwart a disastrous crime in Chernobyl.

programme.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
programme.desc: Jake Pentecost, son of Stacker Pentecost, reunites with Mako Mori to lead a new generation of Jaeger pilots, including rival Lambert and 15-year-old hacker Amara, against a new Kaiju threat.

programme.title: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, young Lara Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: The Alto Knights follow two of New York's most notorious crime bosses and how their separate paths to power place them on a deadly collision course.

programme.title: Aniara
programme.desc: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Tha Fuigheag a’ faighinn trèat ’son a cho-là-breith an-diugh ach, gu mì-fhortanach, chan eil cùisean ag obrachadh a-mach, mar bu chòir! Fuigheag is getting a birthday treat today, but things don’t work out as they should!

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Maigheach, Sionnach, Comhachag agus Tosg a’ faighinn cuireadh gu geama croquet còmhla ri Feòrag. Cò tha a’ nochdadh gun fhiathachadh ach Seoc! Chan eil diù aige do riaghailtean agus tha e a’ milleadh a’ ghnothaich air càch. Dìreach mus fheum iad uile sguir a chluich tha Maigheach a’ cur car anns na riaghailtean agus a’ toirt a chreidsinn air Seoc gu bheil e ri cealgaireachd an uair a tha e ann an dha-rìribh a’ cluich a’ gheama dìreach mar bu chòir. Brush invites Hare, Fox, Owl and Tusk for a fancy game of croquet. Jack shows up uninvited and wants to play, too. But being a villain, he can’t stand rules and ruins the game for everyone. Just at the moment the friends are about to give up, Hare reverses the rules to make Jack think he’s cheating but in fact he’s playing the game perfectly.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Gus nach tachair an aon rud a-màireach, ithidh Pompon biadh “glan” gus nach bi aige ri fhiaclan a ghlanadh. Ach a' cheist mhòr: a bheil a leithid a rud ann ri biadh glan? Pompon missed the sun rising as he had to clean his teeth. To avoid the same happening tomorrow, Pompon decides to eat 'clean' food so as to avoid brushing his teeth. But is there such a thing as 'clean' food?

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Tha Daolag-bhreac air bhioran – an e àite draoidheil a tha seo? E fèir mìorbhaileach! Daolag-bhreac is excited - is this a magic place? It’s just amazing!

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ’S e latha air leth fliuch a th’ ann, is tha Àtaidh a’ lorg toll ann am mullach an taighe. An uair sin tha e a’ mothachadh gu bheil tuill ann an tòrr rudan san taigh aige. Tha e a’ co-dhùnadh toll a chladhach dha fhèin, ach tha e a' steigeadh ann! Ciamar a gheibh Tilidh, Nìp agus na Boga-bogadaich às e? It is a very rainy day and Abney finds a hole in his roof. Then he starts to notice holes everywhere. He decides to dig one of his own but gets stuck in it! How will Teal, Neep and the Poc-Pocs get him out?

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Stan and Gran find a mysterious old carved piece of wood while they are beachcombing. Is it from the wreck of Porthole Pete or a carving of a mermaid? Tha Dan is Gran a' lorg seann phìos fiodha dìomhair a tha snaidht', fhad 's a tha 'd ri lorg-mhuraig. Bheil e ceangailt' ri tubaist mhara seann Peadar a' Phuirt Bhàin, no 'n e maighdeann-mhara shnaidht' a th' ann?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ leughadh Daoine Beaga, Aislingean Mòra: Ella Fitzgerald. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Sanchez Vegara agus a dhealbhachadh le Maria Isabel. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Mòrag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Eilidh Cormack reads Daoine Beaga, Aislingean Mòra: Ella Fitzgerald by Sanchez Vegara, illustrated by Maria Isabel and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha rudeigin dìomhair mun nighean ùr a th’ air an t-sràid – agus dè an gnothach a th’ aice ri trom-laighe Dhaibhidh? Tha Hilda airson a chuideachadh gus am faigh e seachad air an eagal a th’ air aig àm cadail. There is something mysterious about the new girl on the street. And what does she have to do with Daibhidh’s nightmares? Hilda wants to help him get over his fear of night time.

programme.title: Dùbhlain CBBC Alba
programme.desc: Hannah NicKirdy le sùil air ais air cuid de na dùbhlain a chaidh fheuchainn air CBBC ALBA san ùine a chaidh seachad. Hannah McKirdy takes a look at some of the crazy challenges attempted by the CBBC Alba team, including some very competitive cabbage rolling!

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Tha Olaidh agus Coinneach ann an Ruisia agus chan e dìreach sgìtheadh a tha a’ gabhail àite oir tha sinn a’ faicinn tanca, saighdearan a’ caismeachd agus…. geama leigeil-shaighdear? Olaidh and Coinneach are in Russia but skiing isn’t the only thing that’s going on - there’s a tank to be seen, soldiers marching and....a game of skittles?

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Tha Denis 10 bliadhna a dh'aois. Tha fadachd mhòr air gus am bi e cheart cho comasach is fèillmhor ri a bhràthair mòr, Marcus. Ge-tà, le beagan oidhirp’, tha Denis a’ sealltainn dhaibh uile g’ eil e cheart cho tàlantach, na dhòigh fhèin! Denis is ten years old. He is desperate to be as capable and popular as his older brother, Marcus. However, with a bit of effort, Denis shows everyone that he is equally talented, in his own way!

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha na seòid a’ feuchainn rud a-mach às an àbhaist ‘s a’ dèanamh biadh bhèagan. The lads venture out of their comfort zone and go plant-based.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Musician and learner Andrew Findlater joins Joy in the studio and Calum Maclean takes an earthly walk, provoking thoughts of space and the galaxies around us.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Actress, turned interior designer, Erica Macpherson, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Duncan Mackenzie - Dileab a' Ghlinne
programme.desc: Dealas stàcair do dhachaigh a shinnsearan ann an Gleann Inbhir Làthail faisg air Ulapul. Local historian and deerstalker Duncan Mackenzie’s passion for Inverlael Glen, near Ullapool.

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Na tha e ciallachadh a bhith dol tro làn-sgur fuil-mìosa san là an-diugh. What it means to go through the menopause today.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Taghadh den ceòl is òrain bhon seinneadairean 's luchd-ciùil a bha an sàs san t-sreath. A selection of music and song from the series.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Salm 68 air a sheinn le Norrie MacÌomhair agus Sìneag Nic an t-Saoir, an laoidh Mìorbhail Ghràis le Màiri Nic Aonghais agus bidh Donna Barden ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na beatha fhèin. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Psalm 68 sung by Norrie MacIver, the hymn Mìorbhail Ghràis by Mairi MacInnes and Donna Barden tells her personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich. Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Feumaidh an Dùd Beag a bhith far an urrainn dha bhith dùdach fad’ an là. Gu mì-fhortanach, chaidh e air seachran ach fhuair e a shlighe dhachaidh gu Planaid nan Dùd, le beagan taic bho a charaidean ùra Little Dùd needs to be where he can hoot all day. Unfortunately, he goes missing but finds his way back home to Planet Dùd, with a little help from his new friends.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha dùbhradh grèine ann an-diugh ach, gu mì-fhortanach, tha a’ Chearc Iarainn a’ dùbhradh an dùbhradh. Ciamar a gheibh iad air seo a rèiteachadh? There’s a solar eclipse happening today but, unfortunately, the Iron Chicken is eclipsing the event. How will they resolve this?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein a’ fiathachadh a charaidean gu àite-obrach athar. Ach chan eil Dadaidh Pheicein a’ leigeil leotha suathadh ann an dad ach an t-ùrlar, is tha sin a’ fàs dòrainneach. Mu dheireadh thall, tha Dadaidh Pheicein a’ sealltainn dhaibh gun urrainn saorsainneachd a bhith air leth spòrsail. Petit invites his friends to his dad's workplace. But his dad won't let them touch anything except the floor and they start to get really bored. Finally, Petit's dad shows them how carpentry can be lots of fun.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Gilleasbaig Fearghasdan a’ leughadh Fear Coimhid nan Sgòthan. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Tom McLaughlin agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Mòrag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Gilleasbaig Ferguson reads Fear Coimhid nan Sgòthan, written and illustrated by Tom McLaughlin and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha Sebastian a' cur crìoch air an stòraidh, - ag innse mar a dh'fhàs e fhèin is Belle dlùth, an dèidh dha a dìon bho mhuinntir a' bhaile. Sebastian tells the second part of the story, revealing how he and Belle got close, as a result of him protecting her from the people of the village.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Nuair tha taisbeanadh sgoile ri obrachadh air thairis air na saor-laithean – mu bheathaichean sgìreil, tron gheamhradh – tha Camshron ‘son na comharran às àird’ sa chlas fhaighinn, agus, mar as àbhaist, tha e ri foill! When there’s a school presentation to work on in the holidays, about regional animals during winter, Cameron wants the highest marks in the class and, as usual, he cheats!

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha an tuathanach a' co-dhùnadh raon goilf a thogail air an tuathanas gus aire an sguibhir ionadail a ghlacadh. Nuair a mhothachas an treud gun caill iad an dump aca air a bheil iad cho dèidheil, feumaidh iad a thighinn an àrda le plana innleachdail gus a shàbhaladh. The farmer decides to build a golf course on the farm to impress the local squire. When the flock discover they'll lose their beloved dump, they must come up with an imaginative solution to try and save it.

programme.title: Alba Eagalach
programme.desc: Tha sgioba CBBC ALBA a’ toirt thugainn cuid de na sgeulachdan agus na tachartasan as eagalaiche ann an eachdraidh na h-Alba. Anns a’ phrògram seo, gheibh sinn a-mach mu chuid de na nithean neònach os-nàdarrach a tha tric a’ nochdadh ann am beul-aithris le teintean-biorach, caointichean agus tàcharain nam measg. The CBBC ALBA team brings us some of the scariest stories in Scottish history. In this episode, we delve into the paranormal with some of the strangest phenomena in Scottish folklore, including the will-o'-the-wisp, wailing women and changelings.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha pàrantan Munchkin air earbs’ a chur ann, an cafaidh aca a ruith ’son a’ chiad turas, is chan eil e ’son fàiligeadh. Ri linn sin, tha Tabaidh is Flix ‘son a chuideachadh le obair-frithealaidh – ach saoil am bith iad feumail dha? Munchkin’s parents put their faith in him to run their cafe for the first time, and he doesn’t want to fail. As a result, Tabaidh and Flix want to help with serving, but will they be of any use?

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: Fillte, goes on a journey throughout Scotland to discover the history, and contemporary hand-crafted practice behind the artisan producers of woven fabrics, such as wool, hemp, linen, grasses, leather, and many more unorthodox fabrics. Tha Fillte a gabhail turas tro Alba a’ sireadh eachdraidh agus sgeulachdan an latha ’n diugh co-cheangailte ris an luchd-ciùird a tha snìomh ‘s ag obrachadh diofar stuthan, leithid, clòimh, corcach, anart, feur,leathar, agus iomadh seorsa stuth iongantach eile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Counsellor Dolina Munro joins Joy in the studio and Calum Maclean explores a different way to travel on a trip through the city of Edinburgh.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Greim-Bìdh le Gregor
programme.desc: Gregor MacLeod takes fresh langoustines from a local fisherman to make paella, plus raspberry jam from an honesty box is used in a roly-poly.

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Leth-cheud bliadhna às deidh deireadh Cogadh, tha Ramsay MacMahon a’ dol air turas gus faighinn a-mach mar a tha an cogadh agus sgaradh na dùthcha fhathast a’ toirt buaidh air daoine ann am Bhietnam an-diugh. Tro thuras, chì Ramsay seann shaighdearan bhon dà thaobh a tha a’ tighinn aghaidh ri aghaidh airson a’ chiad uair bho thàinig an cogadh gu crìoch. Thèid e a-mach còmhla ri sgiobaidhean a tha ag obair gus bomaichean is mèinnean nach deach an spreadhadh a thoirt às an talamh; agus cluinnidh e sgeulachdan mu dhaoine a tha fhathast beò le buaidh cogadh le stuthan ceimigeach. Half a century after the end of the Vietnam War and the country's reunification, Ramsay MacMahon embarks on a journey to discover how war and division continue to affect people in Vietnam today. During his journey, Ramsay meets former soldiers from both sides who come face to face with each other for the first time since the war ended. He joins teams working to clear unexploded ordnance from the ground; and he hears the stories of people still living with the consequences of chemical warfare. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Taisbeanadh le Màiri NicAonghais agus còmhlan-ciùil aig Na Trads, 2025. Clàraichte beò ann an Obar Dheathain le Mi ’m Shuidhe Nam Ònar agus Kin (Càirdeas) am measg nan òran. A performance by Mairi MacInnes and band at the 2025 Trad Awards. Recorded live in Aberdeen with Mi ’m Shuidhe Nam Ònar and Kin (Càirdeas) amongst the songs.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Suidhichte taobh a-staigh Cearcall na h-Artaig, tha Eileanan Lofoten ann an Nirribhidh a’ tabhann luach fad-beatha de thoileachas don luchd-turais a bhitheas a’ tadhal ann. Air a tharraing leis an t-sreap agus an surfadh air leth a tha ri fhaotainn ann, tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal timcheall nan eilean còmhla ri a chompanach, Calum Gibb, gus eòlas fhaighinn air an t-àite miorbhaileach seo. Situated within the Arctic Circle, Norway’s Lofoten islands offer a lifetime’s worth of exploration in the outdoors. Attracted by the world-class climbing and surfing on offer, Coinneach Rankin journeys around the islands with his companion, Calum Gibb, to glean unique experiences.

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Mu dheireadh thall, tha a triùir leanabain aig Kinga na gàirdeanan, fhad ’s a tha Emily a’ dol tro dheuchainnean a bharrachd. Tha fradharc Diane ann an cunnart, gheibh Treasa agus Ian naidheachd a dh’fhàgas an cridheachan briste, agus tha Tom Òg a’ ruighinn clach-mhìle chudromach. Kinga finally holds her triplets together, while Emily undergoes further tests. Diane faces a risk to her sight, Treasa and Ian receive devastating news, and Tom Óg reaches a key milestone. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Faodail: Beatha nan Eilean (Shorts)
programme.desc: Archive film of communities from the 1930s to the 1980s, illustrating a time of many changes in the way of life on the Outer Hebrides. The strong community ties of past generations still influence the islands today. Filmichean bho Thasglann Faodail | Found Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 1980an, a’ clàradh dhòighean-beatha ag atharrachadh sna h-eileanan, a’ sgrùdadh beatha teaghlaich. Tha ceanglaichean coimhearsnachd làidir nan ginealaichean a dh’fhalbh fhathast a’ toirt buaidh air na h-eileanan an-diugh. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: The community gathers for a fundraiser ceilidh for Old Mary who is recovering from her mill accident. A drunken Boyd confronts Mairead and Cairistiona in front of everyone at the ceilidh. Things turn sour between Johan and Murdina resulting in a mysterious fire starting at the hotel, trapping Murdina and Boyd inside. Will they make it out alive? programme.title: The Stuarts
programme.desc: The final, dramatic act of the Stuart century saw the Stuarts fatally divided by religion: brother versus brother, and two daughters supporting the overthrow of their father. After Charles II's brother, the Catholic James VII and II, was deposed by protestant William of Orange in 1688, Britain became a constitutional monarchy. However, the so-called 1688 'Glorious Revolution' came at a price, as Scotland lost her sovereignty and became part of Great Britain in 1707, whilst Ireland had been reduced from a kingdom to a colony. The politics of resentment has continued to trouble Ireland until the present day.

programme.title: Voyage to Mars: The Longest Goodbye
programme.desc: Nasa intends to send astronauts to Mars. To succeed, crew members will have to overcome unprecedented, life-threatening challenges, and while many of these hazards are physical, the most elusive are psychological. Throughout the expected three-year absence, crew members won’t be able to communicate with Earth in real time due to the immense distance. The psychological impact of this level of disconnectedness and isolation – both from mission control and loved ones – is impossible to predict and endangers the mission itself. Directed to mitigate this threat is Dr Al Holland, a Nasa psychologist whose job is to keep astronauts mentally stable in space. The Longest Goodbye follows Holland, rookie astronauts Kayla Barron and Matthias Maurer and former astronaut Cady Coleman, among others, as they grapple with the tension between their dream of reaching new frontiers and the basic human need to stay connected to home.

programme.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science
programme.desc: The raw, early Earth had plenty of colour, but that canvas was about to be painted with a vast new palette - and the source of those colours was life.

programme.title: The Lost Neanderthals
programme.desc: The Mandrin Cave in southern France has been attracting the attention of archaeologists for 30 years. The cave was regularly occupied in prehistoric times, and a remarkable record of human habitation going back thousands of years has been preserved by its soils. In 2015, the remains of a Neanderthal were uncovered, and the archaeological evidence points to this individual, named Thorin, living in close proximity to newly arrived Homo sapiens. This documentary follows an international team of scientists as they discover and investigate precious relics of the Palaeolithic period, resulting in groundbreaking revelations about the human populations of around 50,000 years ago as researchers uncover some of the secrets of the Mandrin Cave.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Nature documentary. At the jungle animal hospital in Guatemala, the wards are full of exotic patients, many of them orphans rescued from the illegal pet trade.

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: From the magical films of the silent era to the celebrated work of director David Lean and high definition television, this documentary revisits films and interviews from the archive to answer the question of why Dickens's novels have inspired so many hundreds of adaptations on screen. This co-production with Dickens 2012 not only encapsulates the history of Dickens's time, but also of the 100 years in which his work has survived most acutely on screen. It is not only the stories, themes and characters of Dickens's writing that translate so well onto screen - Sergei Eisenstein argued that there is something essentially filmic in his unique prose style; that Dickens's rapid 'cutting' within scenes and from scene to scene coupled with his seamless mixture of the bizarrely comic with the terrifyingly profound was itself proto-cinematic. Dickens wrote the way a camera saw before film had been invented, and he remains to this day the most cinematic of writers.

programme.title: Remembers...
programme.desc: Acclaimed screenwriter Sandy Welch looks back on her adaptation of Charles Dickens's final novel, Our Mutual Friend, as she recounts the challenges in bringing this multilayered gothic story to life. The 1998 drama featured a slew of renowned actors, including Anna Friel, Keeley Hawes, Paul McGann and David Morrissey, and drew praise from critics at the time for its dark, gritty storytelling, winning Sandy a BAFTA for best drama serial of the year.

programme.title: Doorbell Detectives
programme.desc: When burglars target Christine and Gary's shop, taking half-a-million pounds' worth of stock, it’s like something out of a heist movie. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan highlights a worrying new trend called car cannibalism, where thieves strip your car for parts. And we also hear how doggy doorbell detective Truman warns his owners that their high-end luxury car is being pinched from their driveway.

programme.desc: Seaside serenity beckons in Dorset as Sonali Shah helps Norman and Lynda swap city life in London for the calm of the coast. Sonali also takes a break from house hunting to unwind at a rejuvenating seaweed spa.

programme.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
programme.desc: In this episode, the experts lend their skills to a community project, hear the story behind a new treasure to be repaired and visit a local crafting hero. The boys answer a distress call from Swindon, where a plane-shaped bench paying tribute to the town’s aviation history is no longer fit to fly. A local woodworking group have taken on the task of fixing it, but they’re in need of some assistance from master carpenter Will. Meanwhile, Dom meets Tulsi, who has a Hindu holy scripture passed down from her grandmother that’s now so fragile it can’t be opened without further damage. It will take every trick in the book if paper conservator Angie is to get this beloved tome back to a state where the family can use it once again. One of the great joys of leaving the barn is the chance for our experts to meet some of the passionate makers around the country keeping heritage crafts alive. And few are as passionate as Chris, who is buzzing to teach Will all about the traditional way of making skeps, surprisingly strong, traditional bee hives made out of willow.

programme.title: Scotland Stands Up
programme.desc: Join Stuart Mitchell for a brilliant night of stand-up comedy, featuring Jay Lafferty, Ayo Adenekan and Krystal Evans, and a special appearance from Robert Florence. Recorded live at the Church Hill Theatre in Edinburgh, the show is packed with hilarious anecdotes and sharp one-liners from some of the best comedians in Scotland right now. Edinburgh-based American Krystal Evans finds the funny in the differences and similarities in our world views and family values, while rising star Ayo Adenekan wrestles with his identity and reveals his ambitions to become a truly unique Scottish superhero. Jay Lafferty vividly describes the challenges she faces as she gets older to an audience who couldn’t agree more, and our headliner, Robert Florence, who is making a rare stand-up appearance, dons his centurion helmet to make us laugh.

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: Trailer-dwelling, sewage-pumping Chip may not lead the most glamorous life, but he's got one thing going for him: he's head over heels infatuated with his girlfriend, Liza. So when she proposes a plot to steal $68,000, he goes along with the plan. But when what was supposed to be a simple heist turns into an off-the-rails, blood-spattered crime spree, Chip learns the hard way just how deranged the love of his life really is.

programme.title: Uncommon Valor
programme.desc: Col. Cal Rhodes (Gene Hackman), a retired Marine officer, holds out hope that his son, believed to be a prisoner of war in Laos, is still alive. Despite the government's refusal to help Rhodes, he assembles a group to find and rescue his son, including skilled soldiers such as Wilkes (Fred Ward) and Sailor (Randall "Tex" Cobb). Funded by MacGregor (Robert Stack), a wealthy executive also looking for his son, Rhodes leads his men on a dangerous mission into the jungles of Laos.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world.

programme.title: Rosemary's Baby
programme.desc: A young wife comes to believe that her offspring is not of this world. Waifish Rosemary Woodhouse and her struggling actor husband Guy move to a New York City apartment building with an ominous reputation and odd neighbors Roman and Minnie Castevet. When Rosemary becomes pregnant, she becomes increasingly isolated, and the diabolical truth is revealed only after Rosemary gives birth.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou.

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow.

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino.

programme.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
programme.desc: When the man she loves, Holger Olsen, goes off to fight in the Civil War, Vivienne Le Coudy must fend for herself in a place controlled by a corrupt mayor and his unscrupulous business partner. When Olsen returns from the war, he and Vivienne must confront and make peace with the person each has become.

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: Due Justice
programme.desc: Consumed by grief and driven by revenge, a former Marine embarks on a relentless mission to hunt down those responsible for the brutal murders of his beloved wife and daughter.

programme.title: Stop-Loss
programme.desc: His tour of duty in Iraq finally over, Staff Sgt. Brandon King returns home to Brazos, Texas, ready to re-enter civilian life. Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator.

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: On the last day before summer vacation, high school teacher Andy Campbell tries his best to keep it together amid senior pranks, a dysfunctional administration and budget cuts that threaten his job. Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey, greed and hatred, Willie Soke (Billy Bob Thornton) teams up with his angry little sidekick, Marcus, to knock off a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity. Mommy issues arise when the pair are joined by Willie's horror story of a mother, Sunny Soke, who raises the bar for the gang's ambitions, while somehow lowering the standards of criminal behavior.

programme.title: Bucket Lust
programme.desc: Ryan, given less than a year to live, must decide how to spend his final months. With platonic best friend Jennifer faking romance to ease his pain, and his buddy Seth pushing him to tackle his bucket list, Ryan confronts love, truth and mortality.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series.

programme.title: Star Trek: Section 31
programme.desc: Emperor Philippa Georgiou faces the sins of her past after joining a secret division of Starfleet that's tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets.

programme.title: Across the Great Divide
programme.desc: Two orphans (Heather Rattray, Mark Edward Hall) follow a frontier con man (Robert Logan) over the Rockies to their Oregon inheritance.

programme.title: Lena and Snowball
programme.desc: A lonely girl tries to protect a valuable white lion cub from the poachers who kidnapped it and will stop at nothing to get it back.

programme.title: Centurion: The Dancing Stallion
programme.desc: Ellissia adopts a white stallion to train in the art of Mexican horse dancing. As she starts teaching the handsome but previously abused Centurion, Ellissia falls critically ill, which keeps her from competing in a celebrated equestrian event. Under the watchful eyes of her father, new ranch hand Danny steps in as trainer, hoping to win the competition -- and, perhaps, Ellissia's heart.

programme.title: The Snow Queen 2
programme.desc: After the trolls' victory over the Snow Queen, Orm claims that he is destined to marry the princess and inherit great power.

programme.title: House of D
programme.desc: In the present, artist Tom Warshaw recalls his traumatic coming of age. As a 13-year-old growing up in New York City in 1973, Tom hangs out with Pappass, a mentally disabled man. With Tom's mother battling depression after the death of her husband, the young boy is left to his own devices. When Tom develops a crush on schoolmate Melissa, Pappass feels abandoned and begins behaving erratically.

programme.title: Bandslam
programme.desc: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

programme.title: The Great Gilly Hopkins
programme.desc: Young and feisty Gilly Hopkins (Sophie Nélisse) devises a scheme to escape from her new foster home and reunite with her birth mother.

programme.desc: Ham III (Andy Samberg) is the grandson of the first chimpanzee who first blasted into outer space. He and two other chimp astronauts go on a dangerous mission through a black hole. Landing on an inhabited planet, the space-faring simians must help depose a planetary tyrant, then find a way back to their own world.

programme.title: The Blue Elephant
programme.desc: A young, carefree elephant (Thomas Sharkey) becomes separated from his herd and seeks help from new friends.

programme.title: Sea Level
programme.desc: When poachers steal dozens of egg sacks from his reef, bamboo shark Pup makes it his personal mission to save his unhatched brothers and sisters. His rescue mission takes him above water into the world of man.

programme.title: Sea Level 2: Magic Arch
programme.desc: A young dolphin with an active imagination discovers a magic arch that makes wishes come true. However, when its enemies use the arch to become big and strong, it must find a way to stop them.

programme.title: Sea Level 3: Dolphin Boy
programme.desc: A little boy survives a plane crash and is rescued by a young wild dolphin. They grow up together, entertaining marine life with their funny tricks. One day, the peace of their joyful world is destroyed by an evil octopus.

programme.title: A Mermaid's Tale
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Ryan is despondent about moving to a dying seacoast village until she forms an unlikely friendship with a quirky teenage mermaid.

programme.title: Bart Got a Room
programme.desc: Everyone is searching for love in director Brian Hecker's semi-autobiographical story. Danny Stein, a high school senior at the bottom of the social food chain, needs a prom date. As a cause of anxiety for Danny, Bart Beeber, the nerdiest guy in school, has already found a date -- and booked a hotel room. At the same time, Danny's divorced parents are both looking for relationships again.

programme.title: The Blue Elephant
programme.desc: A young, carefree elephant (Thomas Sharkey) becomes separated from his herd and seeks help from new friends.

programme.title: I Can Only Imagine 2
programme.desc: After the success of the song "I Can Only Imagine," MercyMe's Bart Millard has it all until fame starts to cost him what matters most. When hopeful newcomer Tim Timmons joins the band for their biggest tour yet, he unknowingly brings a renewed gratitude to Bart's life.

programme.title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!
programme.desc: The singer-songwriter performs a repertoire of her festive holiday hits, including the chart-topping perennial favorite "All I Want for Christmas Is You."
